record.title: Taba prohibits Israeli outbound travel for COVID prevention, March 2020–March 2021
record.scope: Israeli departures through Taba/Begin crossing to Egypt; earlier foreign-entry prohibition is a separate precursor
record.direction: Israel to Egypt for Israeli citizens
record.movement: Israeli citizens seeking to leave for Sinai; March 2021 permission restored a limited vaccinated/recovered pedestrian category
record.exceptions: Israeli entry was allowed under the 2020 arrangement; that is outside this outbound category. Later inbound restrictions and returnee windows had separate dates. Full earlier outbound exemption practice remains unresolved.
record.imposing_authority: Israeli Interior Ministry and subsequent ministerial arrangements
record.enforcement: Contemporary directive specifies March 18 at 14:00; August official response confirms exit prohibition. March 30 reporting documents limited reopening with travellers present.
record.consequences: Travel restriction; no quantified economic effect established.
record.relationship: Distinct from April 2017 security prohibition and March 8 foreign-inbound precursor R6-ME-L002. Israeli inbound permissions do not contradict an outbound prohibition. Other Jordan crossings in the same March 18 order are not separately counted here.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence only; not a current-status assessment
record.official_rationale: Contain COVID-19 transmission and later variant importation.
record.context: Hebrew contemporary directive and August official response identify an Israeli exit prohibition from March 18. March 8 foreign entry restrictions are a separate precursor, retained as a lead. January 2021 restrictions on returning Israelis are not treated as this episode’s beginning.
record.uncertainty: March 18 is the defined Israeli-outbound commencement, not the first pandemic restriction at Taba. March 30 is limited pedestrian resumption; March 21 regulatory/logistical reports are not a confirmed operational endpoint. Outbound exceptions and uninterrupted operation of the rule are not fully reconstructed.

historical.duration_note: No supported continuous operational interval for the stated scope. Partial category-limited reopening; no continuous-duration calculation without complete outbound exception chronology.
